archive.note: Talk Quest is removed. This manifest retains historical provenance; its assets, paths, and former integration status are not current build requirements.

listing_header_comparison.note: The official product ID matches. The current listing and downloaded archive differ in name, publisher and version. Original downloaded metadata and bytes are retained; these are one acquired product, not two sources.

conversion.source_topology: Preserved; GLB splits vertices at material and normal boundaries.
conversion.skin_weights: Four strongest weights per vertex, normalized by the standard glTF exporter for Web compatibility.
conversion.materials: Exact source FBX linear diffuse values; neutral roughness 0.72, metallic 0; no textures supplied.
conversion.source_animation_selection: Seven evaluated skinned-mesh samples per candidate; reject nonmoving or unbounded takes. At most four semantic clips exported.
conversion.thumbnails: Reviewed source previews cropped to nonzero alpha, fitted within 288 by 288 pixels, and padded by 16 transparent pixels on each edge. Source colors and complete silhouettes are retained.
conversion.runtime_authored_motion: Hit squash/recoil, friendly shrinking retreat, celebration hops, cooperative sleep/breathing/repair glow/wake.
conversion.limitation: Source action names and sampled deformation are evidence; target-game visual/runtime testing is separate.
